summary: Tested self-service account deletion end to end. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_account_deletion.py). It covers deletion info, the DELETE confirm check (400), wrong password (401), wrong or missing code for Google-only users (401), owner-with-members blocked (409, plus blocked_by_members flag), send-code creating an otp, delete -> session revoked -> worker purge -> login 401, testpro login and /auth/me without password_hash, and /auth/session 400/401. Frontend (Playwright on the HTTPS preview): every requested flow passes. Password user: privacy-card, dialog with 4 consequences, submit disabled until both fields are filled ('delete' in lowercase also accepted), 'Incorrect password' toast, 'Keep my account' closes the dialog and clears the fields, correct password + DELETE redirects to /auth?mode=login&deleted=..., the notice shows 'November 19, 2026' (30 days out), and /dashboard then redirects to / (session revoked). Mongo: pending, purge_at +30d, user and org tier cancelled. Restore: re-login shows the toast 'Welcome back! Your account deletion was cancelled.' once only (not again after reload); in Mongo deletion_status and purge_at are removed and deletion_restored_at is set; plan stays cancelled. Blocked owner: delete-account-blocked-note shown, no button. Google-only user: no password field, 'Email me a code' button turns into 'Resend', code input strips non-digits to 6, submit stays disabled until a code is sent, toast 'Invalid or expired code', right code redirects with the notice, sessions and otp removed. Worker: purge removed the user, org and deals and created an account_deletions record. Regression: testpro dashboard and settings (Security, Data sync, Delete account, Current plan, Billing, Renewal) render with no page errors.

minor.issue: utils/rate_limit._ip_key trusts the FIRST X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. Verified: 6 calls with XFF 9.9.9.9 gave 429, and the next call with XFF 9.9.9.10 gave 400 (limit bypassed). This weakens the 5/hour limit on deletion re-auth, so the 6-digit code can be brute-forced by rotating XFF. Pre-existing and app-wide, but relevant here.

Deletion codes share db.otp_codes with 2FA login codes and have no purpose field, so a login 2FA code is also accepted for account deletion and vice versa. Wrong attempts don't use up or invalidate the code (no attempt counter).
For an existing user in 'purging' state, name/picture are updated before on_sign_in raises 401. Harmless but out of order; call on_sign_in before the update.

integration_issues.issue: The toast always says 'Code sent to e2e***@...' even when the backend returns email_sent=false (Resend failed). Show a warning when email_sent is false.

action_items: Optional hardening: make _ip_key use the right-most trusted XFF hop (or the ingress-specific header) instead of the client-supplied first value
Optional: tag otp_codes with a purpose ('login_2fa' / 'account_delete') and check it in _verify_reauth; add an attempt counter
Optional: DeleteAccountCard sendCode should handle email_sent=false with a warning toast
critical_code_review_comments: routes/account.py _purge deletes from every collection matching user_id/org_id. Correct, but it scans all collections; fine for now.
Frontend accepts lowercase 'delete' as confirmation (backend uppercases too). Consistent, but the label says type DELETE.

Transient dev-only build error: the visual-edits babel-metadata-plugin crashed on src/components/intent/PushMenu.js ('Cannot read properties of null (reading traverse)'), and the webpack overlay blocked all clicks. Fixed by `supervisorctl restart frontend`; no code change needed. If it recurs, that dev plugin is the cause.
seed_data_creation: Seeded e2edel01/02/03 users, orgs, session and deals via tests/seed_e2edel.py. All of them were cleaned up afterwards (users, orgs, sessions, otp_codes, deals, sync_schedules), along with the 3 account_deletions records this test created. The 2 earlier account_deletions records (del_b95c462416d6, del_ef2d9c98c75f) are from the main agent and were left in place. testpro was untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python3 /app/backend/tests/seed_e2edel.py seed` before `pytest tests/test_account_deletion.py`. TestZPurge destroys e2edel01, so re-seed before re-running and run `seed_e2edel.py cleanup` afterwards. Tests send random X-Forwarded-For values to avoid the 5/hour limit. Google-only UI flow: set the cookie session_token=session_e2edel02_test on the preview domain. The Playwright sandbox has no pymongo, so a background mongosh loop overwrote the new otp code to a known value.
